user.title: Set up Anova Legacy BLE
user.description: Power on the cooker and press its Bluetooth button so the Bluetooth light is blinking. Choose it below. If it is not listed, choose manual entry.

manual.title: Enter Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address Home Assistant sees for the cooker. A normal address looks like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found {name} at {address}. Keep the cooker powered on and its Bluetooth light blinking for the first connection.
